checks: DC gain and initialized steady state
energy per bit and draw-return identity
independent delayed ideal NRZ zero-error control
known latency retained, not validation retuned
ideal horizontal eye around frozen phase
metrics_self_checks.scope: analytical code controls, not electrical/optical circuit validation

common.temperature_caution: MOS temperature changes only; measured LED DC curve has no temperature model

comparison_screen.interpretation: predeclared teaching comparison screen; not physical BER, qualification, or maximum-rate proof

evidence_boundary: GF180 transistor pre-layout simulation plus assumed LED dynamics and noiseless receiver; no optical BER, silicon, PEX, or tape-out claim
rate_caution: highest passing point among this finite sweep; not the maximum link rate; stress screen reported separately
